name: Mobbin
summary: Searchable library of 621,500 screens, flows and sections from real mobile and web apps.
description: Design-reference library of screenshots from shipped apps and websites: screens, ordered flows, website sections, animations and UI elements, searchable by platform, product, category and pattern. Free tier with limited browsing; Pro and Team plans add full search, flows and MCP or REST API access for agents and teams. Used by product designers and AI coding agents.
contains: browse by apps, sites, screens, flows, animations and UI elements
free tier; Pro $10-15/month; Team $16-24 per member
MCP server on Pro, Team and Enterprise; REST API on Team and Enterprise
search and deep search across products, flows and sections
